info.description:
API for managing movie and TV show watchlists with streaming availability notifications across multiple platforms.

Features:
- User profile and preferences management
- Watchlist CRUD operations for movies and TV shows
- Streaming service subscription management
- Real-time availability checking via TMDb
- Digest email notifications with customizable schedules
- Content search and discovery
info.title: Watchlist Notify API

post.description: Check availability for multiple movies/TV shows across user's subscribed services in a single request. Served from stored availability; prefer GET /api/watchlist, which already embeds availability for every item.

400.description: Invalid request body or exceeds batch size limit

get.description: Check which of the user's subscribed services have a specific movie or TV show available. Served from stored availability (refreshed daily); TMDb is called only for a title that is not stored yet.

200.description: Service catalog with the demo account's selection

404.description: The demo account has not been seeded

get.description: The watchlist of a seeded demo account, in the same shape and with the same filters, sorts and paging as GET /api/watchlist. Public and read-only. A page holds at most 60 items (limit=0 means 60), search is limited to 64 characters, and the response is served from an in-memory copy that is refreshed every five minutes, so it never triggers a TMDb lookup.

parameters.description: Number of items to return (max 60; 0 means 60)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Keep items streaming on any of these service codes (repeat the parameter or separate with commas)
parameters.name: service

parameters.description: Keep items that are (true) or are not (false) streaming on one of the demo account's services
parameters.name: available

parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending): added_at, title, year, status, rating, runtime, available
parameters.name: sort

200.description: Demo watchlist items with pagination metadata and facets

404.description: The demo account has not been seeded

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's complete profile including preferences and service subscriptions, and which optional features the server has switched on

put.description: Links the user's public IMDb Watchlist (by user ID, ur…) or any public IMDb list (ls…), adds its titles to the watchlist now, and keeps the watchlist in step with it once a day from then on. Linking again replaces the link. Titles are added as planned items with source "imdb". Linking itself leaves every item the user already has exactly as it is. The daily sync, from its first run on, adopts items the user imported from IMDb earlier: an item that carries the IMDb ID of a title on the list (which only an import stores), is still "planned" and has no tags gets source "imdb" and follows the list from then on. Items added by hand are never adopted. The daily sync removes an item only if its source is "imdb", the user has not changed its status or tagged it, and it has been missing from two complete fetches of the list at least 12 hours apart. IMDb does not permit public or commercial use of its data, so this is strictly opt-in, stores only IMDb title IDs (everything else comes from TMDb), and reads a list at most once a day: there is no "sync now", and a link request within 60 seconds of a fetch of the user's list (by an earlier link request or by the daily sync) is refused with 429. Every successful request sets linked_at, also one for the list that is linked already.

parameters.description: The IMDb user ID, list ID or URL to link
parameters.name: body

200.description: The stored link and what the first sync did

400.description: Not an IMDb user ID, list ID or URL; or the list is too large

404.description: IMDb has no such list, or it is not public

429.description: The list was fetched less than 60 seconds ago, by a link request or the daily sync

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again

500.description: The link could not be stored

503.description: IMDb sync is not configured on this server

delete.description: Stops syncing with the linked IMDb list. Nothing is removed from the watchlist: items the sync added or adopted stay, and are never removed automatically afterwards. Every "missing from the list" mark (imdb_missing_since) on the user's items is cleared. Unlinking when nothing is linked also succeeds. Within 60 seconds of a fetch of the user's list, by a link request or by the daily sync, the answer is 429 with Retry-After and nothing is changed: the list is still linked; send the request again after that many seconds. On a 500 the list is still linked too.

429.description: The list was fetched less than a minute ago; still linked

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again

500.description: The link could not be removed

post.description: Suggests up to three titles from the user's watchlist that are streaming now on their services, with a one-sentence reason each. Anthropic's Claude makes the choice when there are more than three candidates; each such call counts against a per-user and a shared daily limit. With three candidates or fewer they are returned as they are, and with none the response has empty picks and a message. The endpoint answers 503 unless the server has an Anthropic API key.

parameters.description: What to pick for; every field is optional
parameters.name: body

200.description: Up to three picks, or none with a message

429.description: A daily limit is reached; no model call was made

502.description: The model failed or its answer could not be used

503.description: Recommendations are not enabled on this server

504.description: The model did not answer in time

get.description: Search for movies or TV shows via TMDb API with pagination and filters

Get the user's watchlist with title metadata and streaming availability attached to every item, with optional filtering, sorting and pagination. Availability comes from stored data: the request costs two database queries regardless of list size. The Server-Timing response header reports the database, TMDb and total durations.

parameters.description: Number of items to return (0 for all, max 1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Keep items streaming on any of these service codes (repeat the parameter or separate with commas)
parameters.name: service

parameters.description: Keep items that are (true) or are not (false) streaming on one of the user's active services
parameters.name: available

parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending): added_at, title, year, status, rating, runtime, available
parameters.name: sort

200.description: Watchlist items with pagination metadata and facets

Server-Timing.description: db, tmdb and total durations in milliseconds

post.description: Create a new movie or TV show entry in the user's watchlist

Bulk import watchlist items from an IMDb CSV export (any CSV with a "Const" column of IMDb title IDs). Rows the user already has are counted as duplicates and cost nothing. New titles are added as planned items with source "csv". An import only ever adds; it never removes or changes an item. When TMDb is slow, the rows that could not be looked up in time are reported in "errors"; uploading the same file again continues where it stopped.

400.description: Invalid file or format, or no row could be imported

parameters.description: Watchlist item ID (MongoDB ObjectID hex string)

get.description: Reports whether the API can reach its database. A failed check answers 503 and the process keeps running.

added.description:
Added, Removed and Unmatched are counts from the last run. Unmatched
are IMDb titles TMDb has no movie or show for (episodes, games, …).

last_attempt_at.description: LastAttemptAt is when the list was last fetched, successfully or not.

last_synced_at.description: LastSyncedAt is when the list was last read completely.

source_id.description:
SourceID is an IMDb user ID (ur…, meaning that user's Watchlist) or a
list ID (ls…).

total.description: Total is the number of entries IMDb reported for the list.

imdb_sync.description: IMDbSync is present while the user has a public IMDb list linked.

imdb_missing_since.description:
IMDbMissingSince is set by the IMDb sync when a complete fetch of the
user's linked list no longer contains this item. It is the first of the
two strikes the sync needs before it removes an item; seeing the title
on the list again clears it.

source.description: Source is SourceIMDb, SourceCSV, or empty for items added by hand.

item.description: Item is the watchlist item, as the watchlist endpoint returns it.

reason.description: Reason is one sentence on why it suits tonight.

message.description: Message and EmptyReason explain an answer without picks.

model.description:
Model is the ID of the model that chose, or empty when no model was
called: there was nothing to choose between.

remaining_today.description:
RemainingToday is how many more model calls the user may make before
the next UTC day.

elsewhere.description:
Elsewhere is everything else: services the user does not have, and
rent or buy offers.

link.description: Link is TMDb's "where to watch" page for the title and region.

providers.description: Providers are the user's active services that stream the title.

available.description:
Available and Unavailable split the same items by whether one of the
user's active services streams them.

services.description:
Services counts items streaming on each service code, for every
service that streams at least one.

availability.description:
Availability is null when the title has no stored snapshot: it is not
linked to TMDb, TMDb no longer has it, or the fetch has not succeeded yet.

imdb_missing_since.description:
IMDbMissingSince is set by the IMDb sync when a complete fetch of the
user's linked list no longer contains this item. It is the first of the
two strikes the sync needs before it removes an item; seeing the title
on the list again clears it.

source.description: Source is SourceIMDb, SourceCSV, or empty for items added by hand.

code.description: Code is our service code; empty for providers we do not model.

active.description: Active says whether the demo account has the service.

internal_server.ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response structure used across all endpoints

recommendations.description:
Recommendations is true when POST /api/recommendations/tonight is
available: the server has an Anthropic API key.

source.description:
Source is an IMDb user ID (ur…), a list ID (ls…), or an IMDb URL
containing one.

added.description: Added is how many of them became new watchlist items.

complete.description:
Complete is false when the list was only partly read or some titles
are still to be looked up; the daily sync finishes the job.

existing.description: Existing is how many were already on the watchlist.

total.description: Total is the number of titles on the IMDb list.

unmatched.description: Unmatched is how many TMDb does not know, so they cannot be tracked.

imdb_sync.description: IMDbSync is present while the user has a public IMDb list linked.

error.example: you have used all 10 of today's picks; the limit resets at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z

resets_at.description: When the next day's budget starts.

duplicates.description:
Duplicates counts rows the user already had, or that repeat an
earlier row of the file.

errors.description: Errors lists rows that were not imported, in file order.

imported.description: Imported counts rows that became new watchlist items.

next_offset.description: NextOffset is present when there are more items after this page.

region.description: Region is the region availability is reported for.

total.description: Total is the number of items matching the filters, before paging.

reason.example: no tmdb match for imdb id tt0000001

row.description: Row is the line of the file, counting the header as row 1.

exclude.description: IDs of watchlist items to leave out, such as the ones already suggested. At most 30.

max_minutes.description: Keep titles that run no longer than this many minutes (1 to 600). For a show, one episode.

mood.description: What the viewer is in the mood for, in their own words. At most 200 characters.

type.description: Keep only films or only shows.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token from Auth0 authentication.
